faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before ordering
faq.a1: We ship in discreet packaging worldwide via tracked mail or courier. Once payment is confirmed, orders are prepared within 2 business days and you receive the tracking number by email.
faq.q2: Are the seeds fresh? What is the germination rate?
faq.a2: We only work with recent collector-grade seeds, stored in a climate-controlled environment. The average germination rate is above 85% when planting instructions are followed.
faq.q3: Which payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: We accept PIX (instant approval) for Brazilian customers and credit card for international orders. Your order is only packed once payment is confirmed.
faq.q4: Can I exchange or return my order?
faq.a4: Yes. You have up to 7 days after delivery to request an exchange or return. The product must be sealed and in its original packaging.
faq.q5: How should I store the seeds at home?
faq.a5: Keep seeds in a dry, dark and cool place, ideally in an airtight container. Stored properly they remain viable for many months until planting.
